remarks: Exceptional 1998 colonial on 2.3 pristine, level acres with circular drive and rare 6-car garage capacity-4-car attached plus separate 2-car garage. This impressive residence welcomes you with a dramatic two-story entry hall that sets the tone for refined living. The open floor plan seamlessly connects living spaces, enhanced by 9-foot ceilings and distinctive architectural details including a formal dining room, step-down living room, and a library with custom built-ins.  Thoughtfully updated kitchen and bathrooms blend classic architecture with modern convenience. Five generously sized bedrooms and 4.5 baths include a spectacular primary suite that functions as a private retreat-complete with sitting area, large marble bath, dual walk-in closets, and an attached office or dressing room for ultimate luxury and flexibility. A standout feature: versatile au-pair suite, in-law apartment, or private home office with separate entrance-ideal for multigenerational living, guests, or work-from-home professionals.  The cathedral-ceiling family room with fireplace serves as the heart of the home, perfect for both everyday living and elegant entertaining. Situated on flat, usable acreage with room to play, garden, or simply enjoy the privacy. Car enthusiasts, collectors, and hobbyists will appreciate the exceptional garage space-a rare find in today's market.  Move-in ready with today's finishes and timeless appeal. Schedule your private showing today.
